tgt: Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli.

src: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
tgt: Ere ontegereire onyiguure, ase ayio, ekero ’nde moyo nimbe ’nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.

src: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
tgt: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano,

src: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
tgt: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono kegima, mbairane gochia magega bwango bare nobosooku.

src: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
tgt: igoro mono kobua okogaamba gwonsi, na okobua, ne chinguru, na oborwoti, na igoro ya kera erieta rigwatorwa, tari ase ense eye yoka, korende neria egochia‐gocha boigo.

src: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.”
tgt: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang'ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y'abana, gotugutera chisese.”

src: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
tgt: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang'ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y'abana, gotugutera chisese.”

src: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
tgt: Ekero areenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang'ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateeba: “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”

src: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

src: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
tgt: Kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo kebwate amasio ane; obosio bw’eritang’ani nigo bwarenge buna obw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, na obwa kabere buna obwa Mwanyabaanto, na obwa gatato buna obw’endo, na obwa kane buna obw’ebiongo.

src: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
tgt: “Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.

src: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
tgt: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.

src: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
tgt: Ase kera rituko rie ritang'ani ri'echuma, kera oyomo ase more abe okogaacha mwaye ensemo ase eki anyorire, koreng'ana buna aranyare, erinde ebiegwa tibisangererigwa ekero nachire.

src: So the king and Haman went to dine with Esther the queen,
tgt: Ase igo, omorwoti na Hamani bakagenda koria endagera amo n’Esiteri eting’ana.

src: Basi mfalme na Hamani wakaenda kula chakula pamoja na Malkia Esta.
tgt: Ase igo, omorwoti na Hamani bakagenda koria endagera amo n’Esiteri eting’ana.

src: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh's hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
tgt: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Inee! Nigo orooche ng'a okoboko kwane nokweng'e? Bono norore gose amang'ana ane naikeranigwe ase ore, gose yaaya.”

src: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.' So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”
tgt: Nigo aboria ribaga ri'ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y'abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”

src: Yeye aliomba, ‘Tafadhali niruhusu niokote na kukusanya miongoni mwa miganda nyuma ya wavunaji.' Naye ameshinda shambani tangu asubuhi pasipo kupumzika, isipokuwa kwa muda mfupi kivulini.”
tgt: Nigo aboria ribaga ri'ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y'abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”

src: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

src: Then he crossed over against them first, and all the people after him; and all the Gentiles were defeated before his face, and threw away their weapons, and fled to the temple at Carnaim.

src: Kisha akavuka dhidi yao kwanza, na watu wote wakamfuata; na Mataifa yote wakashindwa mbele yake, wakatupa silaha zao, wakakimbilia hekaluni huko Karnaimu.
tgt: Erio ere akaba omonto bw'eritang'ani kwamboka orooche. Abanto baye bonsi bakamobwatia. Ababisa bagaitwa bobe erio bagatuguta ebirwanero biabo inse na gotama gochia Hekalu yarenge ase omochie o Karinaumu.

src: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

src: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”
tgt: Erio Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, agakwana na Gedalia bobisi agwo Misipa, akamoteebia, “Ing'a ribaga ngende ing'ite Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, na omonto onde tari oramanye amang'ana ayio. Nase ki ere aragoite, erinde Abayahudi bonsi bachire asore baserebekane, na abatigari b'Abayuda basire?”

src: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

src: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?'

src: They took their stand against King Uzziah and said, “Uzziah, you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully; you will not receive honor from the LORD God.”
tgt: Barabwo bagakania Usia omorwoti, bakamoteebia, “Usia, aye tochikiri gosamba ubani ase Omonene, korende abakuani ab’ororeria rwa Aroni nabwo baatananetwe gosamba ubani. Aye soka korwa aiga Aase Aachenu, kwamochire. Omonene Nyasae tagokoa ogosikwa ekiagera gwakorire ayio.”

src: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’

src: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

src: by which they passed over with all their army, these who were covered with your hand, having seen strange marvels.

src: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
tgt: Akabateebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakaboora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”

src: They set up kings, but not by Me. They make princes, but without My approval. With their silver and gold they make themselves idols, to their own destruction.
tgt: “Abaisraeli bebeekeire abarwoti, batamboreti, bebeekeire abagaambi abwo ntamanyeti, na korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu chiabo beroiseirie emegwekano bagosasiima; ayio nigo arabarentere ogosirigwa.

src: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

src: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

src: Better is he who labors and abounds in all things, than he who boasts and lacks bread.

src: A lying witness will perish, but the man who listens to truth will speak forever.

src: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their scheme and that God had frustrated it, each of us returned to his own work on the wall.
tgt: Ekero ababisa baito baigwete ng’a twamanyire emeroberio yabo, naende ng’a Nyasae oyesaririe, tokairana twensi ase okoagacha, na kera omonto agakora emeremo aetwe gokora.

src: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

src: to transfer the kingdom from Saul's house, and to set up David's throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

src: Now the cistern into which Ishmael had thrown all the bodies of the men he had struck down along with Gedaliah was a large one that King Asa had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.

src: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

src: Moreover I have sent Menelaus also, that he may encourage you.

src: You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.
tgt: Omonene oteebire ng’a ase omenyete abanto nigo bagokora oborianania ase oborianania bonde. Na obong’ainereria ase obong’ainereria bonde, bangire konyigwera.

src: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
tgt: Ebinto ebio omorwoti akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai chinyititoire na kobombwa ime ase esike ebombire agwo ase egati ya Sukoti na Sereda, ase riranya ria Yorodani.

src: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. Judah will be besieged, as well as Jerusalem.
tgt: “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokora Yerusalemu obe buna egekombe kere nekenyugwa kegotindia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, boigo nkebanyore Abayuda ekero Yerusalemu orache koboerwa.

src: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
tgt: Na ekero bachia koigwa ng'a nigo agokwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw'Ekeiberania, bakamenta gokira. Agakwana.

src: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
tgt: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nindete omorwoti ore omonene kobua abarwoti bande bonsi, Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, ache korwa sugusu amo ne chibarasi, ne chigari, na abariini be chibarasi, na omoganda omonene bw'abarwani be esegi.

src: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.
tgt: Ekero enyomba yaagachetwe, igo yaagachetwe namagena aseneirie agwo aase areenge kobaacherwa, erinde eriogi ri’enyundo, gose eri’egesire, gose eri’egekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma tikeigugwa ase Hekalu ekero yaagachetwe.

src: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
tgt: Abayuda bairirwe ase obosomba, babeire nemechando na obokong'u batari gotimoka. Nigo bamenyete ase egati y'abanto b'ebisaku; abakobabwatia baabaikereire kobare nemechando.

src: Now the LORD grew angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
tgt: Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase Sulemani, ekiagera enkoro yaye yaonchogete korwa asare ere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oria omoorokerete ara kabere,

src: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
tgt: eyio egotoma abatomwa goetera ase orooche rwa Naeli bariinete amaato aroisirie korwa ase amauncho! Inwe abatomwa more abaango, genda ase abanto b'egesaku bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, bairokire nabaanto bare ang'e, na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo chindooche chinachete.

src: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
tgt: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.

src: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
tgt: Bono tari ng'a nabaanto b'emiaka emenge bare abang'aini, gose tari ng'a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.

src: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
tgt: Erio Petero akamobooria: “Anania, nase ki ogwancha Saitani gokobogoria okong'aina Omoika Omochenu na kobisa ensemo ye chitaabu kwanyora korwa ase omogondo?

src: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
tgt: Omonene oigoire ase agachete ebirwanero biaye, na ase endamwamu yaye obisokirie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabwate emeremo agokora ase ense y’Abakalidayo.

src: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
tgt: Naki igo nagogete mono ekero abaminto bachete baganteebia igoro y’obwegenwa bwao ore nabwo ase ekeene, na buna ogendererete ase ekeene.

src: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
tgt: Batiseba agatugama inse ase okoorokia amasikani ase omorwoti, na omorwoti akamobooria: “Ninki oganetie?”

src: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God's house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
tgt: Erio nkomana nabanene nkababoria, “Nase ki enyomba ya Nyasae yatigirwe etarendiri?” Nkabasangereria na nkabeka kera omonto aase aye akore emeremo.

src: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
tgt: Rituko rikobwatia togaika Sidoni. Yulio akarenda Paulo buya, akamoa ribaga agende ase abasani baye akonywe nabarabwo.

src: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
tgt: Naki titori kwerandia intwe abanyene, korende Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, na intwe abanyene buna abasomba baino ase engencho ya Yeso.

src: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.
tgt: Na orente ching’iti ase obwato ime, na chinde chionsi chire moyo, korwa ase kera egesaku, ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, chibe moyo amo naye.

src: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.
tgt: Onye omokungu oria takorete obotomani korende nigo are omoikeranu, rirorio tagokorerwa bobe, otatiga aibore abana.

src: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
tgt: Erio nkarigereria, nkaigwa egeturi ki’abamalaika abange abarenge baetanaine ekerogo keria ki’obonene ne ching’iti chiria chire moyo, na abagaaka baria; na omobaro obo nigo orenge chilifu ikomi ara chilifu ikomi, ne chilifu ara chilifu.

src: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
tgt: Korende momanyete Timotheo na ogokora kwaye, buna akorerete enchiri amo nainche. Igo are koreng'ana buna omwana okomokorera ise.

src: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
tgt: Inchuo ase ’nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.

src: “Njooni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotaabika na kulemewa na mizigo, nami nitawapumzisha.
tgt: Inchuo ase ’nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.

src: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,

src: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,

src: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
tgt: Ning'o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?

src: Basi, ni nani atakayewadhuru mkiwa wenye juhudi katika kutenda mema?
tgt: Ning'o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?

src: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
tgt: Erio ekero ’ndabe natongirie omorero agwo Misiri, na abakoonyi baye bonsi basirigwe, barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

src: Ndipo watakapojua kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapoiwasha Misri moto na wote wamsaidiao watapondwa.
tgt: Erio ekero ’ndabe natongirie omorero agwo Misiri, na abakoonyi baye bonsi basirigwe, barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

src: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
tgt: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Obobe obo bwanyorete, tiga naye bokonyore! Inakoa omoiseke one omosomba koboko kwao; ere, ekero achia korora ng’a obeire morito, onchayire. Tiga Omonene atwatanane inche naye!”

src: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
tgt: Aba bakoraria Kristo ase esuugu gose tari ase omoyo omorabu, bakorengereria komenta obororo bwane ase ogosibwa kwane.

src: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
tgt: agaaka abachandi baye bagatama gochia ase barwete, akababeeka ase obosooku goika kare na kare.

src: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
tgt: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

src: Atai akamzaa Nathani, Nathani akamzaa Zabadi,
tgt: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

src: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
tgt: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Ahira, mosinto o Enani.”

src: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
tgt: Naki abanto babo bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare ne ribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.

src: Then they each said to his neighbor, “Let's repair the ruins of our people. Let's fight for our people and the holy place.”
tgt: Korende barabwo bagateebania, Bono tiga toagaache oboyia egesaku giaito! Torwane toegerere abanto baito na egesasiimero giaito.

src: Kisha kila mmoja akaambiana na mwenzake, “Tutengeneze magofu ya watu wetu. Tupigane kwa ajili ya watu wetu na mahali patakatifu.”
tgt: Korende barabwo bagateebania, Bono tiga toagaache oboyia egesaku giaito! Torwane toegerere abanto baito na egesasiimero giaito.

src: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can't come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.'”
tgt: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

src: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Watu hawawezi kupanda mlima Sinai kwa sababu wewe mwenyewe ulituonya ukisema, ‘Wekeni mipaka kuuzunguka mlima na kuutenga kama patakatifu.' ”
tgt: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

src: He did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
tgt: Ere agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene, buna aya onsi Usia ise akorete.

src: Akafanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana, kama Uzia baba yake alivyokuwa amefanya.
tgt: Ere agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene, buna aya onsi Usia ise akorete.

src: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
tgt: Ninde nokoganyererera okonene n'ogosemeria ng'a tingosookigwa ase enchera ende yonsi, korende ase oboremu bwane bwonsi, bono buna botambe, Kristo naegwe ogosika ase omobere one, keraabe ase obogima gose ase ogokwa.

src: I was nursed with care in swaddling clothes.
tgt: Inkaboigwa chianga chi'abana, 'nkarendwa ase enchera engiya.

src: Nililelewa kwa uangalifu nikiwa nimevaa nguo za kitoto.
tgt: Inkaboigwa chianga chi'abana, 'nkarendwa ase enchera engiya.

src: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.
tgt: Igwa eriogi ri'abaanto bagotama korwa ase ense ya Babiloni, bakoraria ase Sayoni igoro y'Omonene, Nyasae oito, buna akoruseria Hekalu yaye egesiomba.

src: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn't listen.
tgt: Omonene agakwana na Manase na abanto bonsi, korende bakaanga koigwera.

src: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of these tithes to the storerooms of the treasury in the house of our God.
tgt: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

src: Kuhani atokanaye na uzao wa Aroni atashirikiana na Walawi wakati wanapopokea zaka, nao Walawi itawapasa kuleta sehemu ya kumi ya zaka katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu katika ghala za hazina.
tgt: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

src: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
tgt: oyoruetwe ase ogokwa ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na akabokigwa ekiagera otorenteire oboronge.

src: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
tgt: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokuungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakuure.

src: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
tgt: “Irania omoyio ase ekeraaro kiaye! Agwo ase ense mwatongeretwe, ense y'obobiare bwaino, nao 'ndabanachere ekiina.

src: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
tgt: Barabwo kobarakoborie ng’a ng’ai bakogenda, obateebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto baria bagochia gokwa ase oborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo, na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero; baria bagochia gokwa ase enchara, bakwe nenchara, na baria bagochia gwoswa, booswe bairwe.

src: Nao kama wakikuuliza, ‘Twende wapi?’ Waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “ ‘Wale waliowekwa kwa ajili ya kufa, wakafe; waliowekwa kwa ajili ya upanga, kwa upanga; waliowekwa kwa ajili ya njaa, kwa njaa: waliowekwa kwa ajili ya kutekwa, watekwe.’ ”
tgt: Barabwo kobarakoborie ng’a ng’ai bakogenda, obateebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto baria bagochia gokwa ase oborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo, na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero; baria bagochia gokwa ase enchara, bakwe nenchara, na baria bagochia gwoswa, booswe bairwe.

src: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
tgt: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw'oborimo nigo agokwana obong'ainereria.

src: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, as Manasseh his father did.
tgt: Amoni agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, buna ise akorete.

src: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
tgt: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

src: Jambo hili likaendelea kwa muda wa miaka miwili, kiasi kwamba Wayahudi na Wayunani wote walioishi huko Asia wakawa wamesikia neno la Bwana. Wana Wa Skewa Wajaribu Kutoa Pepo Mchafu
tgt: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

src: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
tgt: Naki amang’ana aya karabe ime yaino na komenteka, nabakore timoba aboro gose abanto motari nokwama, ase okomomanya Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

src: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
tgt: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

src: God's anger burned because he went; and Yahweh's angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
tgt: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.

src: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
tgt: Akanachana chinyama chi'emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi'enda na ebirenge namaache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, n'ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi'emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

src: Mose akamkata yule kondoo dume vipande vipande na kukiteketeza kichwa, vile vipande na yale mafuta.
tgt: Akanachana chinyama chi'emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi'enda na ebirenge namaache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, n'ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi'emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng'wanso kegosaambwa n'omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

src: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
tgt: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

src: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
tgt: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

src: Kulikuwa na vita vinavyoendelea kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
tgt: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

src: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
tgt: Ase ayio ekero abanto b'ebisaku bionsi na ab'emenwa yonsi baigwete eriogi ri'ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amariogi a kera egento ki'amatera, bonsi bakaba bagatung'ama na gosasiima omogwekano bw'etaabu, oria omorwoti konya atenenetie.

src: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.
tgt: Naende Isumaeli agaita Abayahudi bonsi barenge amo na Gedalia agwo Misipa, agaita nabasikari b'Abakalidayo abwo banyorekanete bare aase agwo.

src: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
tgt: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

src: Ndiyo sababu mpaka leo makuhani wa Dagoni wala wengine waingiao katika hekalu la Dagoni huko Ashdodi hawakanyagi kizingiti.
tgt: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

src: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
tgt: Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora egetabu eringanirie ekoiruruka.

src: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
tgt: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.

src: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
tgt: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

src: Huyu ndiye “ ‘jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilikataa, ambalo limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.’
tgt: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

src: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
tgt: Ase ayio Omokuani akaa Daudi emegati eria emechenu, ekiagera mogati onde torengeo otatiga eria konya yarusigwe korwa ase obosio bw'Omonene, erinde eyere iberera ebekweo ase rituko erio.

src: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests. The Death of Joash (2 Chronicles 24:23–27)
tgt: Chibesa chiarenge koruegwa ase okorongeyia okomocha, na echio chiarenge koruegwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe tichiarentetwe ase enyomba y’Omonene; echio nigo chiabeete echi’abakuani.

src: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

tgt: Korende Amunoni tancha komoigwa. Ere akamobua chinguru, akamokorera obosooku ase okoraara nere.

src: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?
tgt: Nigo okorengereria buna Abaisraeli nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa? Nigo Omoika bw’Omonene asirie okoremereria kwaye? Ekeene ere nakore ebinto ebio? Tari gokwana ase obwororo ase baria bagokora ay’ekeene?

src: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
tgt: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoirwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.

src: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
tgt: Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y'amaache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.

src: I have not sinned against you, but you have done me wrong by waging war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.”
tgt: Inche ase ayio tindakora ebibe ase ore; aye nigo ogokora bobe ase ’nde ase ogokora esegi nainche. Omonene nere omogaayani. Ere reero iga nanache ekiina gati y’Abaisraeli n’Abaamoni.”

src: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.
tgt: Ase ayio bakeonchora, bagatama korwa ase Abaisraeli gochia ensemo y'erooro, korende bakanarigwa nabarwani baria abange, na baria barwete ase omochie, bagaitwa.

src: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
tgt: Omorwoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamoteebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”

src: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
tgt: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Inaki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”

src: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
tgt: Nikobogorie ase ogochaaya naende ngotube ne eubi. Abanto mbakorigererie n'omondoko.

src: If he continues, he will leave a greater name than a thousand. If he finally rests, it is enough for him.

src: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”
tgt: Ekero mogosoa ase omochie namomonyoore ritang'ani ataratiira gochia ase ekegoro koragera. Abanto tibakoragera ritang'ani ataraikao, ekiagera ere goika asesenie ekeng'wanso keria. Erio baria barangeirie banyare gochaaka koragera. Ase ayio, genda bwango, ekiagera ase engaki eye nero moramonyoore.”

src: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
tgt: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang'ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na obong'aini buna aye.

src: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
tgt: Na ekero omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda arenge ase orogendo inchera, akaumerana nendo, ero ekamoita agakwa. Omobere oye ogatugutwa ase enchera, na etigere na endo chigatenena mbarabare ase omobere oria.

src: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
tgt: Ase ayio, nimbakorere amabe inde nendamwamu. Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera. Nabaisa korera baake eriogi rinene ase ’nde, tinkobaigwa.”

src: I saw every work of God, and that a man is unable to comprehend the work that is done under the sun. Despite his efforts to search it out, he cannot find its meaning; even if the wise man claims to know, he is unable to comprehend.
tgt: Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteeba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.

src: Then I ordered that the rooms be purified, and I had the articles of the house of God restored to them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense. Tithes Restored (Leviticus 27:30–34; Deuteronomy 14:22–29; Deuteronomy 26:1–15)
tgt: Nkarua ogochika, na aase agwo agachenwa, erio nkairaniao ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ubani.

src: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
tgt: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.

src: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
tgt: Erio Yusufu akagwera ise ase obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.

src: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
tgt: Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.

src: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

src: For they are Your people and Your inheritance; You brought them out of Egypt, out of the furnace for iron.

src: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
tgt: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki'obokuani, na egesibao ki'obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera emeremo y'obokuani.

src: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?

src: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

src: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

src: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left. Josiah Destroys Idolatry (1 Kings 13:1–10; 2 Kings 23:4–20)

src: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”

src: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.

src: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

src: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

src: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
tgt: Erio Orinani agateebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omorwoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi'okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw'endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”

src: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
tgt: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.

src: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, to provoke him to anger.
tgt: Erio naende 'nkarara maumama ase obosio bw'Omonene buna agwo ritang'ani, ase engaki y'amatuko emeronge ene, omobaso n'obotuko. Tinabeete 'nkoria kende gose konywa, ase engencho y'ebibe bionsi inwe konya mwakorire, ase ogokora amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, mokamogeechia goika akaba n'endamwamu.

src: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,

src: Kutoka pale akaenda Beer-Sheba.
tgt: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

src: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
tgt: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.

src: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don't fear God.
tgt: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.

src: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
tgt: Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye gochia sugusu asirie Abaasuri; nasirie na Ninawi obe bosa, na ayuomie obe erooro.

src: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
tgt: Nkwanerie Rufo omochorwa Omonene, na ng’ina ore buna baba ase ’nde.

src: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
tgt: “Abamoabu babeire barendire bamenyete ase obotoereru korwa ase oboke bwabo. Babeire buna edivai etarakenonorwa korwa ase eturubo. Tibana koumorwa korwa ase ekebekerero ekemo gochia ase ekende, gose tibana gwoswa bairwe ase obosomba. Ase ayio rimisu riabo nabo rigendererete koba buna riarenge, na ogotioka kwabo tikwana koonchoka.

src: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

tgt: Nainwe mwakorire amabe kobua chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera kera oyomo oino nigo akobwatia obomwenu bw'enkoro yaye embe, bwanga konyigwera.

src: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man's heart was continually only evil.
tgt: Omonene akarora ng'a obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto bwabeire obonge ase ense, na kera okoroberia na okorengereria gwe chinkoro chiabo nokobe botambe.

src: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
tgt: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Eke nakio kerabe egetari kiaino ndabae, ekiagera mwanyebire na mwasemeirie amang’ana ’oborimo.

src: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
tgt: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha ase more beboyetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chintindi mono.

src: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
tgt: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

src: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.” A New Song of Praise (Psalms 98:1–9; Psalms 149:1–9)
tgt: Rora, amang’ana nateebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobaraareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.” Ogoteera kw’ogotogia

src: Tazama, mambo ya kwanza yametokea, nami natangaza mambo mapya; kabla hayajatokea nawatangazia habari zake.” Wimbo Wa Kumsifu Bwana
tgt: Rora, amang’ana nateebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobaraareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.” Ogoteera kw’ogotogia

src: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment. The Power of Faith (Luke 17:5–10)
tgt: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.

src: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
tgt: Ase eriogi riaye amaache are igoro chionsi akoeera neriogi, nigo akorenta ritaturi korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.

src: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
tgt: Korende onye mokogenderera gokora ebibe, rirorio nigo morasirigwe amo nomorwoti oino.”

src: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
tgt: Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagateera nechinkoro chire nomogooko.

src: When the young woman would go to the king, she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
tgt: Ekero omoiseke arenge gochia ase obosio bw’omorwoti, nigo arenge koegwa korwa ase enyomba y’abaiseke baria egento kende gionsi arenge kogania koira.

src: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.
tgt: Erio Elisha agateebia omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli: “Imokia emegwe!” Nere akayeimokia. Naende akamoteebia: “Rasa inse ase riroba!” Nere akarasa inse ase riroba ara gatato, agatiga.

src: Behold, Yahweh's word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
tgt: Erio ring'ana ri'Omonene rikamochiera Aburamu naende, rigateeba: “Omonto oyio, tari ere oraire omwando oo, otatiga omwana oo bori, orarwe ase enda yao, nere oraire omwando oo.”

src: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
tgt: Abamerari nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: chibao chi'Obomenyo Obochenu, n'emeriibo, ne chisiiro, ne chinterekerero, amo nebikorero biabo bionsi. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

src: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
tgt: Korende abanto abange bakamentwa ase abegeeni omoganda omonene bw’abasacha na’abakuungu abwo begenete omonene.

src: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
tgt: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Saridi riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate emeika eria etano na ebere ya Nyasae, ne ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere. “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Nore nerieta ng’a moyo ore, korende nigo okwete.

src: “Kwa malaika wa kanisa lililoko Sardi andika: “Haya ndiyo maneno ya aliye na zile Roho saba za Mungu na zile nyota saba. Nayajua matendo yako, kwamba una sifa ya kuwa hai, lakini umekufa.
tgt: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Saridi riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate emeika eria etano na ebere ya Nyasae, ne ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere. “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Nore nerieta ng’a moyo ore, korende nigo okwete.

src: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
tgt: Omonene akarora ng'a monto onde tarenge aande, agakumia ng'a onde tarenge gwesoyia gokonya. Erio okoboko kwaye omonyene gokamorentera ogotooreka, na oboronge bwaye bokamokonya.

src: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.
tgt: Onye enyomba eria egwenerete, tiga omorembe oino oyeikere; ko onye tegwenereti, omorembe oino nobairanere inwe.

src: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
tgt: Labani agancha amang'ana ayio, agateeba: “Tiga abe buna gwateebire.”

src: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food. The Year of Jubilee
tgt: Boigo ching’iti chitugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie. Omwaka bw’Omochengo

src: vilevile malisho ya mifugo yenu na wanyama pori katika nchi yenu. Chochote nchi itakachozalisha kinaweza kuliwa. Mwaka Wa Yubile
tgt: Boigo ching’iti chitugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie. Omwaka bw’Omochengo

src: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.
tgt: Korende ekero enkoro yaye yeimokereretie igoro, na omoika oye okong'ete na koenena, nigo aseretigwe korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki'oborwoti, akaurwa obonene bwaye.

src: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
tgt: Barabwo mbarie chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, na okwama kwe riroba riaino, goika mosirigwe kegima. Tibakobatigareria endagera yaino, gose edivai, gose amaguta, gose chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, gose chimanwa chi’eching’ondi n’echie chimbori chiaino; ’nabagere mosire kegima.

src: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
tgt: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ogotooreka na egesusuro Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.

src: Naye atakuwa amani yao. Ukombozi Na Uharibifu Wakati Mwashuru atakapovamia nchi yetu na kupita katika ngome zetu, tutawainua wachungaji saba dhidi yake, hata viongozi wanane wa watu.
tgt: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ogotooreka na egesusuro Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.

src: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
tgt: “Naroche oboriri ase ababani ba Samaria, nigo barenge kobana ase erieta ri'enyasae Baali, na gotantania abanto baane Abaisraeli.

src: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
tgt: Ase kera amatabekania ye chinchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasiimera, kwanyakairie oboseera bwao, gwechwarire ase onde bwensi ogoeta, na gwakorire obonyaka obonge.

src: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
tgt: Korende ebiooreri bi’okoorera na ebimitero bi’edivai tibigoisanekia abanto, na edivai enyia tekonyorekana ase bare.

src: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:
tgt: Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura, ere arore ebibe bionsi ise akorete, korende airoke na takora amang’ana buna ayio.

src: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
tgt: Inyora ng'a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y'amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”

src: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”
tgt: Ankio mambia, ekero erioba rigosoka, moimoke bwango, moumokere omochie. Erio ekero Gaali n'abanto baria bare komo bakobaachera kobarwania, mobakorere buna amaboko aino aranyare ekero ekio!”

src: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
tgt: Ase rituko erio erio Aburaamu akarokigwa amo na omwana oye Isumaeli.

src: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
tgt: Eri'Omonene Nyasae agasimeka ebimeri ase omogondo aaria Edeni, ensemo ya moocha, erio akabeeka omonto aroro, oria abombete na koroisia.

src: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
tgt: Boigo Abaisraeli bande, abwo konya bebisire ase ebitunwa bi'ense ya Efraimu, ekero baigwete ng'a Abafirisiti batamire, nabarabwo bakababwatia nomokia gochia kobarwania.

src: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
tgt: Ere nigo akorenta ogosiria kwa mobosokano ase abwo bare ne chinguru, boigo nagere ogosareka gochere chiburi chinkong’u.

src: and say to them, Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn't hear the words of this covenant,
tgt: obateebie: Aya nar'Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aragererigwe omonto otari koigwera amang'ana 'okobwatana oko

src: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
tgt: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,

src: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.
tgt: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,

src: Esther replied, “If it pleases the king, may the Jews in Susa also have tomorrow to carry out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”
tgt: Esiteri akamoiraneria, “Omorwoti korarore mbuya, Abayahudi aba bare agwo Susa baegwe ribaga ankio boigo bakore koreng’ana nogochika kwa reero; tiga abamura ba Hamani ikomi batongwe ase chimbambo igoro.”

src: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
tgt: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, ekero Daudi omorwoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.

src: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
tgt: Orosenge ndwarenge bosio bw'ebinyomba biria bi'oborendi, na obogare bw'egesona keria nigo bwarenge obw'okoboko okomo. Ebisona bi'ebinyomba ebio bie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo biareng'aine. Kera akanyomba nigo karenge nobogare bw'ekerengo ki'amaboko atano na rimo, na obotambe bwaye boigo.

src: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
tgt: Aya naro omorwoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria.

src: Don't talk much with a foolish man, and don't go to one who has no understanding. Beware of him, lest you have trouble and be defiled in his onslaught. Turn away from him, and you will find rest, and you won't be wearied in his madness.
tgt: Moreere oyo kure ekiage ere tari goikeera borabu bonde; naende moreere omonto omoriri ekiagera tari na semi. Tobaisa komoreera moono omonto okuure ekigera ere otimokire; korende moreere omonto omoriri, ekiagera obogima bwaye n'obobe kobwa amakweri.

src: Usiseme sana na mpumbavu, wala usimwendee mtu asiye na ufahamu. Jihadhari naye, usije ukapata shida na kujitia unajisi katika mashambulizi yake. Mgeukie, nawe utapata raha, wala hutachoka katika wazimu wake.
tgt: Moreere oyo kure ekiage ere tari goikeera borabu bonde; naende moreere omonto omoriri ekiagera tari na semi. Tobaisa komoreera moono omonto okuure ekigera ere otimokire; korende moreere omonto omoriri, ekiagera obogima bwaye n'obobe kobwa amakweri.

src: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
tgt: Kwana amang'ana aya, ase okobua gwonsi ore nakwo, kuurera, na gotogonyera abategereri bao. Tibwanchera omonto onde bwensi agochaaye.

src: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron's sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
tgt: Erio omonto oria onyeenyete eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi'egesasiimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano.

src: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.” Witnessing to All Nations (Matthew 24:9–14; Mark 13:9–13)
tgt: Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana y’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”

src: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
tgt: chora abanto abang’aini, abare abamanyi, abanto bamanyekanete buya korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbabeeke babe abataang’ani baino.

src: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
tgt: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabateebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.

src: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
tgt: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ’gokobugia obokano.

src: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath. And he too saved Israel, striking down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad.
tgt: Oyomobwatetie Ehudi ase obogaambi, nere Samugari, mosinto bw’Anati. Ere agaita Abafirisiti amagana atano na rimo n’enyimbo are gotemera chieri. Nere boigo akabatooria Abaisraeli.

src: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
tgt: “Geenda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng'a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Inee! Nong'agaachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?

src: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:45–56; Mark 15:33–41; Luke 23:44–49)
tgt: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.

src: kisha akamwambia yule mwanafunzi, “Nawe huyo hapo ndiye mama yako.” Tangu wakati huo yule mwanafunzi akamchukua mama yake Yesu nyumbani kwake. Kifo Cha Yesu (Mathayo 27:45-56; Marko 15:33-41; Luka 23:44-49)
tgt: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.

src: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, “What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.”
tgt: Ekero Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ateebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”

src: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
tgt: Amatuko 'egesusuro aikire, ee, amatuko ay'ogoakanera ogokora kw'abaanto aikire. Abaisraeli mbamanye ayio. Omobani obeire omoriri, na omonto ore n'Omoika obeire ebarimo, ekiagera obobe bwaino bwabeire obonge, na okogecha kwaino kwabeire okonene.

src: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus. Doxology (Jude 1:24–25)
tgt: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, baabakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chitaabu, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, baabakwanirie.

src: Gayo, ambaye ni mwenyeji wangu na wa kanisa lote, anawasalimu. Erasto, mweka hazina wa mji huu, pamoja na Kwarto ndugu yetu pia wanawasalimu. [
tgt: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, baabakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chitaabu, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, baabakwanirie.

src: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
tgt: Korende inabarierete inwe eira ng’a nimbae ense yabo ebe omwando oino, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaatananire inwe korwa ase ebisaku binde.

src: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
tgt: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

src: Basi Isaki akawaandalia karamu, nao wakala na kunywa.
tgt: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

src: And that is just what happened to him. The people trampled him in the gateway, and he died.
tgt: Ayio agakoreka asare, na abanto igo bamotindacherete agwo ase egeita, agakwa.

src: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
tgt: Omorero ore ase egesasiimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka, torima. Kera emambia Omokuani ameente chinko ase omorero oyio, naende achooke buya ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa igoro ase chinko echio na asaambe ebitinya bi'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe.

src: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
tgt: Erio abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw'embori eria ekoruegwa ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na ayenyeenyere agwo ase ebing'wanso bi'ogosaambwa bikonyeenyerwa.

src: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,
tgt: Rebeka agateebia Yakobo, omwana oye: “Naigure iso ogoteebia momura omino Esau:

src: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
tgt: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

src: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.”
tgt: Arusie oborwoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omorwoti, agaambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”

src: In Jerusalem, then, Jeremiah the prophet relayed all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah
tgt: Erio Yeremia omobani agateebia Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda amang’ana ayio onsi agwo Yerusalemu,

src: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
tgt: Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang'ana 'obororo, naende kwang'akanire amabe 'obosae bwane.

src: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

tgt: Abimeleki akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Aande monto onde oito areenge gochia araare na mokao, na aye anga nigo gwatobeka ase okomocha.”

src: Did not Hezekiah himself remove His high places and His altars and say to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before one altar, and on it you shall burn sacrifices’?
tgt: Inee! Hezekia oyo tari ere oria osaririe aase aimokererete igoro agwo ase Omonene agosasimerwa, amo nebisasimero biaye? Naende ere agachiika Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, ogoteeba: Bosio bw’egesasiimero ekemo nao morasasimere, na igoro ase kerokio mobe mokorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.

src: Je, si Hezekia mwenyewe aliyeondoa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu pamoja na madhabahu zake, akiwaambia Yuda wa Yerusalemu, ‘Ni lazima mwabudu mbele ya madhabahu moja na kuteketeza dhabihu juu yake’?

src: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
tgt: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na ase ekenyoro gionsi, morigie ning'o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.

src: Then Daniel laughed, and said, “O king, don't be deceived; for this is just clay inside, and brass outside, and never ate or drank anything.”
tgt: Danieli agaseka erio akamoiraneria omorwoti: “Tong'aineka; ime yomogwekano oyio namaroba oka na isiko nechuma, ere tanakoria gose konywa gento kende gionsi.”

src: Ndipo Danieli akacheka, akasema, "Ee mfalme, usidanganyike; maana hii ni udongo tu ndani, na shaba nje, wala haijawahi kula wala kunywa chochote."

src: “This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year.

src: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
tgt: Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.

src: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
tgt: Ase igo Obadia akagenda, agateebia Ahabu amang'ana ayio; erio Ahabu akagenda korotota Elija.

src: Mordecai went out robed in royal apparel, wearing a golden crown and a diadem of fine purple linen. The people in Susa saw it and rejoiced.
tgt: Tibaisanegeti n'egesururo korwa ase enkoro ya mwanyabaanto, korende nigo bakogokigwa n'abanto abwo bagwakanwa ase amaya, batamanyeti ng'a onsi nigo are ase amaiso a Nyasae, nigo bakagerete ng'a mbetange korwa ase endamwamu yaye y'ogokumia gochia ase abanyabibe.

src: Mordekai alitoka nje akiwa amevaa mavazi ya kifalme, amevaa taji ya dhahabu na taji ya kitani safi ya zambarau. Watu wa Susa waliona hayo wakafurahi.
tgt: Tibaisanegeti n'egesururo korwa ase enkoro ya mwanyabaanto, korende nigo bakogokigwa n'abanto abwo bagwakanwa ase amaya, batamanyeti ng'a onsi nigo are ase amaiso a Nyasae, nigo bakagerete ng'a mbetange korwa ase endamwamu yaye y'ogokumia gochia ase abanyabibe.

src: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
tgt: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ng'ina oy'omoiborete.

src: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.

src: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
tgt: Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.

src: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
tgt: Onde bwensi orakune ebiraarero bi’omokuungu oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

src: Keep a strict watch over a headstrong daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to your enemies, a byword in the city and notorious among the people, and shame you in public.
tgt: Omorende mono omoiseke omoenenu, onye taribo ere nagere osekererwe na ababisa bao, aye obe gokogambwa na oyore nerieta ribe ase abanto, akorentere obosooku ase risango riabaanto.

src: Mlinde sana binti mkaidi, asije akakufanya kuwa kichekesho kwa adui zako, dharau mjini na sifa mbaya miongoni mwa watu, na kukuaibisha hadharani.
tgt: Omorende mono omoiseke omoenenu, onye taribo ere nagere osekererwe na ababisa bao, aye obe gokogambwa na oyore nerieta ribe ase abanto, akorentere obosooku ase risango riabaanto.

src: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
tgt: Nonya ndero ekero amachiiko a Musa agosomwa, egietubo keria ngetubete ase chinkoro chiabo.

src: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
tgt: Ekero barasoke isiko mbarore emebere ekwete y’abanto abwo basaretie korwa ase ’nde inche Omonene. Amakonde arabe akoria emebere yabo tagokwa, na omorero orabe okobasamba tokorima. Abwo bakwete mbabe okogechia okobe ase abanto bonsi.”

src: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
tgt: Nere otongete chinkoro chi'abaanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.

src: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
tgt: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta ase bare ore moyo.

src: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
tgt: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagaamba emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng'ina nigo arenge korokwa Abia, mosubati o Zakaria.

src: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
tgt: Timoria chinyama chie ching'iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.

src: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
tgt: nigo ararirende ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba ase omotienyi o kabere. Narie emanwa y'eng'ondi y'Epasaka amo n'emagaati etabekiri ememera, ne chinyeni chindoro.

src: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
tgt: Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw'ebibe nkobe ase more buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang'e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.

src: Katika siku hizo Israeli hawakuwa na mfalme, kila mmoja akafanya kama alivyoona vyema machoni pake mwenyewe.
tgt: Ase amatuko aria omorwoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi arooche kere ekeronge aase okorora kwaye ere omonyene.

src: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
tgt: Inee! Sokoro yaito Aburaamu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasiimero?

src: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
tgt: Nigo moraibore abana, abamura na abaiseke, korende tibakoba abaino, mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.

src: Utakuwa na wana na binti lakini hawatakuwa nawe, kwa sababu watachukuliwa mateka.
tgt: Nigo moraibore abana, abamura na abaiseke, korende tibakoba abaino, mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.

src: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
tgt: Ninche natongete ense, ngatonga na abanto, nkababeeka aroro; amaboko aane naro aramborete igoro, erio ngachiika erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, kera ekemo kebeere aase aye.

src: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
tgt: Aye Omonene Nyasae oito, nigo obwate amaabera, naende nigo ogotwabera, nonya twasaririe ase ore.

src: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
tgt: Agachia koyaigwa, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

src: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

src: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.

src: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
tgt: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.

src: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh. But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left.

src: But the people pleaded, “You must not go out! For if we have to flee, they will pay no attention to us. Even if half of us die, they will not care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It is better for now if you support us from the city.”

tgt: Eri'Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore riire ime, agakwana na Musa, na akaa abagaaka baria emerongo etan'ebere korwa ase omoika oria oria orenge ime ase Musa. Ekero omoika oria obete igoro ase bare barabwo bakabana, korende tibagenderera gokora igo naende nonya ndinde.

src: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

src: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places.
tgt: Naki konya ochikiire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)

src: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
tgt: Monto onde tari orabarwanerere. Eriogo ri'amaote aino tiriri, okogwenigwa tikori ase more.

src: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
tgt: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga mono, bakaboora, “Omonene, tororere amaabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”

src: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull's blood, and some of the goat's blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
tgt: Erio asoke agende ase egesasiimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay'eeri gose ey'embori eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye ching'unchara ere ase chikoona chi'egesasiimero ekio,

src: for he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.
tgt: Erio agatoma amarube gochia ase chingongo chionsi chi'obogambi bwaye. Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw'engencho y'amariko abo, ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo, goteeba ng'a kera omosacha abe okogamba ase enka yaye, naende abe ogokwana nabaanto baye ase omonwa bw'egesaku kiaye.

src: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

src: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakushughulikia kama unavyostahili, kwa kuwa umedharau kiapo changu kwa kuvunja Agano.
tgt: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng'ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw'ogotianania.

src: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
tgt: “Buna abakuani bagendererete kobucha, naboigo bagendererete gokora ebibe ase ’nde. Ase ayio ning’onchore obonene bwabo bobe obosooku.

src: If adversity meets you, you will find him there before you. Pretending to help you, he will trip you.
tgt: Oise konyorwa n'obokong'u, nagwo okomonyora okoganyete, okwebonia ng'a nkogokonya are, na anii, nigo aroberetie kogokoora kegima.

src: Ikiwa shida itakupata, utamkuta hapo mbele yako. Akijifanya kukusaidia, atakukwaza.
tgt: Oise konyorwa n'obokong'u, nagwo okomonyora okoganyete, okwebonia ng'a nkogokonya are, na anii, nigo aroberetie kogokoora kegima.

src: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
tgt: Amato aye nigo arenge amaya, na amatunda aye nigo arenge amaange; ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Ching'iti chi'orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera inse yaye, ne chinyoni chikaba chikomenya ime ase chinsagia chiaye, na kera egetongwa kere moyo gekanyora endagera yaye korwao.

src: Each day one ox, six choice sheep, and some fowl were prepared for me, and once every ten days an abundance of all kinds of wine was provided. But I did not demand the food allotted to the governor, because the burden on the people was so heavy.
tgt: Kera rituko endagera narenge korua neng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi chinoru isano nemo, amo ne chingoko; na kera rituko ria ikomi nigo narenge korua ebirandi ebinge biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, bire nedivai. Ase ebinto ebio bionsi tinarenge gosaba endagera eria abagaambi bagwenerete koegwa, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babogoretie egurube endito.

src: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
tgt: Obonyakieni nigo bokong'ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.

src: Kujipamba ili kuvutia ni udanganyifu na uzuri unapita upesi, bali mwanamke anayemcha Bwana atasifiwa.
tgt: Obonyakieni nigo bokong'ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.

src: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
tgt: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amaange.

src: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
tgt: Akagenda naende ng'umbu ya Yorodani goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang'ani, akabeera aroro.

src: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
tgt: Zedekia agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna onsi aria Yehoyakimu akorete.

src: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
tgt: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

src: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
tgt: Korende enchera y'abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogeenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.

src: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
