src: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit. Jesus’ Side Is Pierced (Zechariah 12:10–14)
tgt: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo. Yeso okobetwa ritimo na koirwa gotindekwa

src: Baada ya kuionja hiyo siki, Yesu akasema, “Imekwisha.” Akainamisha kichwa chake, akaitoa roho yake. Yesu Achomwa Mkuki Ubavuni
tgt: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo. Yeso okobetwa ritimo na koirwa gotindekwa

src: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
tgt: Oiranerie amang'ana aya okwane ase obosio bw'Omonene, Nyasae oo: Sokorooria yane nigo arenge Omoaramu, orenge okona‐koong'anyang'anya. Agatirimboka gochia Misiri, akaba omomenyi aroro amo n'abanto baye. Ekero ageendete ase ense eria nigo abwate abanto abake, na aroro agwo bakabucha, bakaba egesaku ekenene, kiarenge n'echinguru, naende kiarenge n'abanto abange.

src: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
tgt: Inwe mobe abachenu baane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde omochenu, nabaatananire korwa ase ebisaku binde, erinde mobe abaane.

src: But Saul replied, “You cannot go out against this Philistine to fight him. You are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.”
tgt: Saulo agakania Daudi, akamoteebia: “Tokonyara korwania Omofilisti oyio. Aye nomoke; ere nigo enaretie korwana esegi korwa obosae bwaye.”

src: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
tgt: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.

src: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
tgt: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli mbabwatane n'Abamisiri na Abaasuri, na ebisaku ebio bitato mbibe ogosesenigwa ase ense engima,

src: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
tgt: Nase ki mogendererete gosaria? Nigo moganetie konyora egesusuro goetania? Omotwe bwonsi orwarire, na enkoro yanyarekire.

src: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
tgt: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

src: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
tgt: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi'etaabu, na ebi'efeta, na ebi'etai.

src: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
tgt: Chinibo chi'ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.

src: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven. The Lesson of the Fig Tree (Matthew 24:32–35; Luke 21:29–33)
tgt: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mat 24:32-36,42; Luk 21:29-33)

src: Naye atawatuma malaika wake wawakusanye wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka miisho ya dunia hadi miisho ya mbingu. Somo Kuhusu Mtini (Mathayo 24:32-35; Luka 21:29-33)
tgt: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mat 24:32-36,42; Luk 21:29-33)

src: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
tgt: Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka, ninche engeero yabo bagochaaya.

src: and the idols will vanish completely.
tgt: Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.

src: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
tgt: Timoa monto onde ribaga ri'okobaura inwe ekeegwa kiaino ase okorigia kwaye ase okweororobia na ase ogosasiima abamalaika, na kwebeka ase amaroro aya arorire, na koenena bosa ase ebirengererio biaye bi'obobe,

src: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'
tgt: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!

src: Kwa maana wakati utafika mtakaposema, ‘Wamebarikiwa wanawake tasa, ambao matumbo yao hayakuzaa, wala matiti yao hayakunyonyesha!'
tgt: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!

src: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
tgt: Musa akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,

src: “Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.”
tgt: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.

src: Sema na Yerusalemu kwa upole, umtangazie kwamba kazi yake ngumu imekamilika, kwamba dhambi yake imefanyiwa fidia, kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana maradufu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
tgt: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.

src: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
tgt: Nigo nkobamanyia igoro y’omokia inde noro ase engencho yaino, boigo na ase abanto bare Laodikia na baria bonsi batarandora obosio bwane,

src: The women, girded with sackcloth under their breasts, thronged the streets. The virgins who were kept indoors ran together, some to the gates, others to the walls, and some looked out through the windows.
tgt: Abakungu nabarabwo bakebisia chigunia ase ebikuba biabo bagaichora ase chinchera. Abasubati abekungi abwo konya batarancherwa gosoka isiko korwa ase chinyomba chiabo bakamonyoka bagaeta ase ebiita n'echinyasi chi'omochie, nabande bagatigara barigereretie korwa chitirisa.

src: Wanawake, wakiwa wamevaa magunia chini ya vifua vyao, walijaa mitaani. Mabikira waliokuwa wamefungiwa ndani walikimbia pamoja, wengine hadi malangoni, wengine hadi ukutani, na wengine walichungulia madirishani.
tgt: Abakungu nabarabwo bakebisia chigunia ase ebikuba biabo bagaichora ase chinchera. Abasubati abekungi abwo konya batarancherwa gosoka isiko korwa ase chinyomba chiabo bakamonyoka bagaeta ase ebiita n'echinyasi chi'omochie, nabande bagatigara barigereretie korwa chitirisa.

src: Then the elders of the congregation said, “What should we do about wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?”
tgt: Abagaaka b’omosangererekano oria bakaboorania, “Naki torakore tonyorere abasacha baria batigarete abakungu, ekiagera abakungu bonsi baitirwe korwa ase Ababenjamini?”

src: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
tgt: Ase ensemo ya moocha y'omogondo o Edeni akabeeka ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, n'omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi. Erio korenda onde bwensi tacha ase omote bw'obogima.

src: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.
tgt: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abeete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.

src: The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd.
tgt: Amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana nigo anga buna chimbambo chinyoge, na aya basangereirie anga buna emesumari eakeire bokong’u. Ayio onsi nebiegwa korwa ase Omorisia oyomo.

src: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked. “There, in the tent,” he replied.
tgt: Barabwo bakamobooria: “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria: “Neema ime are.”

src: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
tgt: Egutwa eyio negenderere kobeera ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene koba ekeinyorio kia Helidai, na Tobia, na Yedaya, na Heni, mosinto o Sefania.

src: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him, they placed him in custody.
tgt: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.

src: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
tgt: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw'ogotianania nainwe, ng'a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n'amaache y'etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y'ayio.”

src: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”
tgt: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw'ogotianania nainwe, ng'a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n'amaache y'etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y'ayio.”

src: Depart from wrong, and it will turn away from you.
tgt: Korebachere amabe, amabe natame korwa asore.

src: Jiepushe na uovu, nao utakugeukia mbali.
tgt: Korebachere amabe, amabe natame korwa asore.

src: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
tgt: Na amarieta abotomwa baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bw'eritang'ani, Simioni, oyio ore korokwa naende Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;

src: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
tgt: Inwe mobogorie Sikuti, omogwekano oyio mogosasiima buna omorwoti oino, na Kiyuni, enyasae yaino ye ching'enang'eni mweroiseretie.

src: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
tgt: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y'abaminto.

src: Kwa namna hii twaweza kulijua pendo la Mungu: Kwa sababu Yesu Kristo aliutoa uhai wake kwa ajili yetu. Nasi imetupasa kuutoa uhai kwa ajili ya hao ndugu.
tgt: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y'abaminto.

src: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.'”
tgt: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

tgt: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

src: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
tgt: Ekero bwachia gokia rituko riare kobwatia, abarai ba Abayahudi, abanene, amo n'Aborokia b'amachiiko bagasangererekana ime ya Yerusalemu.

src: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father's brothers' sons.
tgt: Abaiseke obwo ba Selofehadi; Maala, Teresa, Ogila, Milika, amo na Nuhu bakanywomwa n'abamwabo korwa are ororeeria rwa ise.

src: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
tgt: Ekero abana babo bare isiko mbaitwe n'emioro, ekero bare ime ase chinyomba obwoba mbobaite; ebio mbiite abamura, na abaiseke, na abana bakogonka, amo n'abanto abagotu.

src: For he called upon the Most High Lord, and he gave him strength in his right hand to kill a man mighty in war, to exalt the horn of his people.
tgt: Ekiagera ere amosororete Omonene Nyasae nere agatenenia okoboko kwaye gwokorio, erio ere anyare komobua omobisa omonyanguru ase esegi na kobasegeta abanto baye.

src: Kwa maana alimwomba Bwana Aliye Juu Zaidi, naye akampa nguvu katika mkono wake wa kuume ili amuue mtu hodari vitani, ili kuinua pembe ya watu wake.
tgt: Ekiagera ere amosororete Omonene Nyasae nere agatenenia okoboko kwaye gwokorio, erio ere anyare komobua omobisa omonyanguru ase esegi na kobasegeta abanto baye.

src: “Go and look toward the sea,” he said to his servant. So the servant went and looked, and he said, “There is nothing there.” Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”
tgt: Magega y’ayio Elija agateebia omosomba oye: “Tiira gochia igoro, origererie gochia ase enyancha.” Omosomba oye agatiira, akarigereria, akamoteebia: “Tindochi gento kende.” Ase chintunda isano na ibere Elija akamoteebia: “Genda origererie!”

src: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
tgt: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng'a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.

src: Saul's uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
tgt: Ise moke Saulo akabooria Saulo na omosomba oye: “Ng'ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria: “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”

src: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
tgt: Egesaku kia Rubeni keegwe orogongo rw'aye robebekane norwa Efraimu korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

src: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
tgt: Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,

src: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret; it leads only to evildoing.
tgt: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.

src: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
tgt: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Aburaamu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,

src: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
tgt: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y'egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.

src: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
tgt: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.

src: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
tgt: Inaki Omonene nache aete ense ya Misiri aite Abamisiri, korende ekero ararore amanyinga agindirie omoriibo bw'emetobwa ya gesieri igoro na emetobwa eria ebere, nigo araete egesieri ekio, gose tagotiga oria omosiria asoe chinyomba chiaino abaite.

src: “To the worthy Jewish citizens, Antiochus, king and general, wishes much joy and health and prosperity.
tgt: “Korwa ase omorwoti Antioko, gochia ase Abayahudi, abanto baane abanchwa. Kobatomera inde amaiga y'obwanchani, na kobaganeria obogima obuya, n'okogenderera kwaino.

src: "Kwa raia wa Kiyahudi wanaostahili, Antiochus, mfalme na jenerali, anawatakia furaha nyingi, afya na ustawi."
tgt: “Korwa ase omorwoti Antioko, gochia ase Abayahudi, abanto baane abanchwa. Kobatomera inde amaiga y'obwanchani, na kobaganeria obogima obuya, n'okogenderera kwaino.

src: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.
tgt: Rangeria abanto bamanyete korwanera amata bachiche korwania Babiloni. Moyoboere ase chinsemo chionsi, timotiga nonya nomonto oyomo atame atooreke. Yoakane koreng'ana nogokora kwaye. Buna koreng'ana oro okorete tiga okorerwe boigo, ekiagera omochie oyio oenenire ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli.

src: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
tgt: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,

src: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
tgt: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng'a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng'a amatuko onsi nigo areng'aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.

src: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
tgt: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge ase ore komenyana na moka momura omino.”

src: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
tgt: Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Sihori ya Misiri goika egesoero kia Hamati, erinde barente Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa Kiriati‐Yearimu.

src: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
tgt: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

src: Bwana Mungu wetu alifanya Agano nasi katika mlima wa Horebu.
tgt: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

src: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
tgt: Ere bworokereirie amaboko ane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko ane anyare gokumba obota bw’etai.

src: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children.
tgt: Ase engaki eria nareengeo omonto ore korokwa Manoa. Nigo arenge korwa omochie ore korokwa Sora, omonto bw’egesaku gia Dani. Omokungu oye nigo arenge omogomba, taiborete bana.

src: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.”
tgt: Enyomba yao na oborwoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”

src: Nyumba yako na ufalme wako utadumu milele mbele zangu, kiti chako cha enzi kitafanywa imara milele.’ ”
tgt: Enyomba yao na oborwoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”

src: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
tgt: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omoororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateeba, “Nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”

src: Gain trust with your neighbor in his poverty, that in his prosperity you may have gladness. Stay steadfast to him in the time of his affliction, that you may be heir with him in his inheritance.
tgt: Nonya gwaikigwe gotwara enkwano enkong'u n'omosani oo, tokwa omoyo; ekiagera naende nabo obosani bokogorororwa naende bobeo

src: Jiaminishe na jirani yako katika umaskini wake, ili katika mafanikio yake upate furaha. Mtegemee wakati wa mateso yake, ili upate kuwa mrithi pamoja naye katika urithi wake.
tgt: Nonya gwaikigwe gotwara enkwano enkong'u n'omosani oo, tokwa omoyo; ekiagera naende nabo obosani bokogorororwa naende bobeo

src: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
tgt: Ekero ekio ense eye yonsi neonchorwe ebe ense omweya korwa Geba goika Rimoni, Irianyi ya Yerusalemu. Korende Yerusalemu oro nogenderere kobeera igoro agwo aase aye, korwa ase Egeita kia Benjamini goika ase Egeita kie Ritang’ani, na goika ase Egeita gi’Ekoona, na korwa ase Omorobiri bwa Hananeli goika ase ebimitero bi’edivai bi’omorwoti.

src: Nchi yote kuanzia Geba, kaskazini mwa Yuda, hadi Rimoni, kusini mwa Yerusalemu, itakuwa kama Araba. Lakini Yerusalemu utainuliwa juu na kubaki mahali pake, toka Lango la Benyamini hadi mahali pa Lango la Kwanza, mpaka kwenye Lango la Pembeni na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli hadi kwenye mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.

src: Mtonyama had heard that an imbulu's tail loves milk and that it can't go past milk without drinking some. So he told his men to dig a deep ditch and to fill the ditch with sour milk. Then he called all the girls of the village to take part in a jumping competition.
tgt: Mtonyama konyora oigure buna ekemincha k’ieimbulu nigo gianchete amabere naende tikegoetania mabere getaranywa nonya namake igo. Igo agatebia abamura baye bareme engoro nakoyeichoria n’amabere amaruranu. Erinde akabarangeria abaiseke bonsi bekenyoro basindane

src: One day her parents decided to send her to stay with her rich Uncle Mtonyama. Nonkungu's mother made a special skirt with ribbon, buttons and beads. She also made a beautiful bead necklace for Nonkungu. Then she sent her off to her uncle's village.
tgt: Rituko erimo, abaibori baye bakaamua komotoma gochia komenya na Ise moke orenge etachiri naende orenge korokwa Mtonyama. Ng’ina Nonkungu akamoroseria esikati yabwate emengori, ebibungo amo namaritati ande. Naende akamoroseria rindere ri’ebigoti.

src: Long long ago people didnt know anything. They didnt know how to plant crops, or how to weave cloth, or how to make iron tools. The god Nyame up in the sky had all the wisdom of the world. He kept it safe in a clay pot.
tgt: Igabwo kare kare banto tibamanyete kende. Tibamanyete gosimeka endagera, gose gosona yanga, gose korosia ebinto korua ase chichuma. Nonya nigo nyasaye orenge korokwa Nyame narengeoo gotatiga amenyete igoro ase rise naende nigo abwate obong'aini bwensi bwense. Nigo agachete obong'aini obo ase enyongo.

src: Khayanga heard her mothers voice saying to her: Our child, pick up the pieces that are left. Fetch water with them and wash your feet. When you finish washing, close your eyes. Khayanga obeyed and suddenly, the broken Gourd became whole once again.

src: Anansi spun a long thread, and climbed up his sticky thread all the way to heaven. "Can I have the stories, please?" he asked the Sky God. But Nyame laughed at Anansi and said, "Oh, these are very expensive stories. You wouldn't be able to pay for them, little spider."

src: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. src: To prevent Fall Armyworm infestation, use high-quality, disease-free seed, avoid late or staggered planting, and increase plant diversity in your plots (for example intercropping) to make maize less attractive to armyworm moths.

src: Ili kuzuia uvamizi wa minyoo ya Fall Armyworm, tumia mbegu za hali ya juu, zisizo na magonjwa, epuka kupanda kwa kuchelewa au kwa kuyumba, na uongeze utofauti wa mimea katika mashamba yako (kwa mfano kilimo kiingiliano) ili kufanya mahindi yasivutie nondo za jeshi.

src: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.

src: Ili kudhibiti nematodes katika nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (mbegu ya kilo 2 kwa lima) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kukua nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali ambayo hufukuza nematodes. Ondoa au lima kwenye mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zao, kisha panda nyanya zako.

src: Based on the seasonal rainfall forecast, adopt appropriate soil and water conservation measures: if rains are predicted above normal, focus on controlling erosion, protecting crops from flooding, and water harvesting; if below normal, focus on conserving soil moisture.
